doc.title: Emile Barnes and Paul Barnes Interview, 1959-10-01

chapter: Paul Barnes: Last tour with King Oliver
title: Hard times on the road with Oliver and closing of the tape
summary: Paul tells of breakdowns, quitting men and his loyalty to Oliver through 1935; the tape ends.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: Right in your book there from that time.
From that time. Yeah. I'll tell you the rest after you. Well. That's the last tape you got.
No, see, we want to find out, go ahead, another half a minute on here.

Well, anyway, I'll make this short for you. That was in 34, I stayed with King until 1935 and during that time we had lots of trouble, buses break down. I read about that, yeah. Sometime that we'd almost go over the accident, I liked it, went over the hills and we had men that was quitting and no one would stay with the King. I loved the old King so much, I just wouldn't, wouldn't, I wouldn't let him down. I just stuck with him, see, when all was leaving. And King, he looked like he wasn't too worried. He admired me so much. As long as he had me with him, he seemed to be satisfied. Okay.
